banner.title: searxng
banner.tagline: A private metasearch backend that Hermes calls for web search, with a rate limiter and no public listener.

explainer.title: One query fans out, one limiter holds the door

steps.title: Secret
steps.text: The ExternalSecret renders SEARXNG_SECRET, the instance signing key, from 1Password item searxng into the container environment.
steps.scene: a sealed key placed into a slot

steps.title: Settings
steps.text: A ConfigMap mounts settings.yml and limiter.toml read-only. The limiter is on, the image proxy is on and public instance mode is off.
steps.scene: a settings panel with plain toggle switches, no text

steps.title: Query
steps.text: uWSGI runs 4 workers with 2 threads each on port 8080. Each query fans out to the enabled engines and merges the results.
steps.scene: one beam splitting into five plain hexagon nodes, no letters, no logos

steps.title: Limit
steps.text: The limiter keeps its counters in Dragonfly, through SEARXNG_REDIS_URL. Requests from the LAN ranges are passed through, and bot checks cover everything else.
steps.scene: a turnstile gate with a glowing counter panel, no digits

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Hermes calls searxng.ai.svc on port 8080. People reach the UI on envoy-internal at the search subdomain, and Gatus checks /stats.
steps.scene: a search bar plugged into a cable

art.about: a private metasearch service that fans a query out to engines, with a rate limiter in front
